nl: 库存盘点管理：查询有商品名、仓库；表格展示商品名、仓库、系统数量、实盘数量、盘点状态（未盘/已盘/差异）；支持新增、编辑、删除。后端列表接口返回的是 { list: [...], totalCount: N }，请据此做响应字段映射。
nlEn: Inventory count management: query by product name and warehouse; the table shows product name, warehouse, system quantity, actual quantity, and count status (not-counted/counted/discrepancy); supports add, edit, and delete. The backend list endpoint returns { list: [...], totalCount: N }, so map the response fields accordingly.
notes: AI-08: backend returns { list, totalCount } → flat configTableOut mapping (vue3/schema)
